audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Skill at levels 4-5 and at level 6, while its own whys say Teemo kites the whole 4-5 pattern and level 6 is Nautilus' one real kill window.
audit.why: Packet levelChart: Skill, Teemo, Teemo, Teemo, Nautilus, Teemo, Teemo — Depth Charge is point-click and ignores both the blind and Move Quick.
audit.corrected: Both layers set to Skill, Teemo, Teemo, Teemo, Nautilus, Teemo, Teemo with ratings to match.

audit.why: Spikes: levels 1-2 point-blank hook, level 6 Depth Charge, first item blind lockout, late shroom control. Consistent with the corrected chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: The blind is described vaguely as cancelling autos, and the page twice claims Teemo deals percent-health damage ('His blind + %HP + kite', 'Stack pure HP vs %damage'). Nothing in his kit is percent health — Toxic Shot is on-hit magic poison.
audit.why: Riot text: Blinding Dart (Q, 680, flat 7s) blinds. Because Staggering Blow needs an attack to land, a blind means the pull leads nowhere — the mirror audit states the same. Toxic Shot carries only the onHit flag.
audit.corrected: Blinded, Staggering Blow cannot root, so bait the 7-second Blinding Dart before you hook. Build magic resist against on-hit poison rather than raw HP against a percent-health threat that does not exist.

edits.before: Level 1 is roughly even because neither of us has a real all-in yet — but the moment he has Blinding Dart he turns every step I take into free poison poke, since my whole kit leans on autos (passive root, W splash burn) that his blind erases. My single play is a flat-side Q hook: land the anchor, get yanked in, passive-root and dump E, then leave. Miss that one skillshot and there is nothing — he just Move Quicks out of E range and chips me with poison while I eat minion aggro. Do not throw Q at a Teemo who is holding his blind; bait it first or hold it for a hook you can actually hit.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay his — my W shield and E scaling don't matter when his Move Quick keeps him outside my anchor range and his poison ticks me down from afar. Level 6 is my one window: Depth Charge is homing and undodgeable, so for once his blind and his move speed don't save him — fire R, it knocks him up, and I chain passive-root, Q, and E-slow on top. That's the trade I'm playing the whole laning phase to set up. Once R is on cooldown, though, I'm back to walking into a wall of blind and poison, so I need that one R to convert into a kill or a summoner, not a wasted poke.

Level 6 is your one window: Depth Charge is homing and undodgeable, so for once the blind and the move speed do not save him — fire R, it knocks him up, and you chain passive-root, Q and E-slow on top. That is the trade you play the whole laning phase to set up. Once R is on cooldown you are back to walking into blind and poison, so that R must convert into a kill or a summoner.

edits.before: This is where it falls apart. My damage is tank-only and front-loaded, so once he has items his poison and on-hit kite just out-DPS anything I bring, and his blind makes my autos worthless in any extended fight. The bigger problem is the map: shroom walls on every choke and every brush mean I can't even path to him without revealing myself and eating a poison tick, and without R up I have no way to close the gap. My only hope is that my one good Level 6 R already turned into a lead — if I'm even or behind by the time he has two items, he zones me off the side lane and there's nothing my low base damage can do about it.

notes: Two things removed as unsupported: the percent-health damage claim (Teemo has no percent-health effect in his kit) and the 'Move Quicks' spelling flagged in suspectNames — Move Quick is now used correctly. Content layer was first-person throughout and is converted to second person at matched length. Per the mirror, no knock-up line was written for Noxious Trap: the mushroom slows, it does not displace.
